name: One Life To Live
overview: Scripture teaches that each person has only one life to live, after which judgment follows, emphasizing the urgency of wise living. Jesus affirms the reality of death while promising eternal life to those who believe in Him, highlighting the critical choice between temporal existence and everlasting life. Believers are called to walk carefully and wisely, fully aware that their earthly life is brief and that the kingdom of God will be revealed in power.
